Observability, recovery and production admission

A source-linked technical walkthrough. Trace the flow, explain the boundary, then test the failure path.

After this session, you can:
  • Read service health without leaking tenant data
  • Explain recovery evidence
  • Assemble go-live gates

Technical flow

Every hand-off is a control boundary: on failure the flow holds, refers or denies — it never skips ahead.

  1. 01Telemetry + alerts
  2. 02Incident
  3. 03Fail closed / contain
  4. 04Recovery package
  5. 05Four-eyes restore
  6. 06Exercise evidence
  7. 07Production admission

1. Observe

Bounded route metrics, latency/availability SLIs, SLO and error-budget state, provider health and stuck-work alerts support operations. Platform metrics avoid tenant labels; tenant health is role-gated.

2. Recover

Encrypted recovery packages validate India residency, checksums and audit-chain integrity. Authenticated four-eyes restore, RTO/RPO measurement and witnessed exercises prove more than a backup file exists.

3. Admit

Production admission joins live integrations, security, resilience, data, staffing, policy, migration, UAT, model risk, operating procedures and independent assurance. Evidence expires and must be renewed.
